expertText:
* = $0801

.include "macros", $1500
; --------------------------------------------------
; RAM variables
; --------------------------------------------------
.const frame_idx   = $C100
.const points      = $C110

.const src_lo      = $09
.const src_hi      = $0A

.const draw_bmp_hi = $10
.const dbuf_bank   = $11

.const x0v       = $20
.const y0v       = $21
.const x1v       = $22
.const y1v       = $23
.const dxv       = $24
.const dyv       = $25
.const sxv       = $26
.const syv       = $27
.const errv      = $28
.const cntv      = $29
.const dx2v      = $2A
.const dy2v      = $2B
.const edge_idx  = $2C

start:
    SEI
.invoke DisplayOff

; VIC bank 0: $0000-$3FFF
    LDA $DD00
    AND #%11111100
    ORA #%00000011
    STA $DD00

; hires bitmap on
    LDA #$2B
    STA $D011

; make sure multicolor bitmap is off
    LDA $D016
    AND #%11101111
    STA $D016

; screen=$0400, bitmap=$2000
    LDA #$18
    STA $D018

; black border/background
    LDA #$00
    STA $D020
    STA $D021

; screen color nybbles: white fg / black bg (bank0)
    LDA #$10
    LDX #$00
fill_scr1:
    STA $0400,X
    STA $0500,X
    STA $0600,X
    INX
    BNE fill_scr1

    LDX #$00
fill_scr2:
    STA $0700,X
    INX
    CPX #$E8
    BNE fill_scr2

; init double buffering (fills bank1 screen at $4400, sets ZP)
.invoke DbufSetup

    LDA #$00
    STA frame_idx

    ; draw frame 0 while display is off, then enable
    JSR clear_bitmap
    JSR load_frame
    JSR draw_cube
.invoke DbufSwap
.invoke DisplayOn

main_loop:
    INC frame_idx
    LDA frame_idx
    AND #$0F
    STA frame_idx
    JSR clear_bitmap
    JSR load_frame
    JSR draw_cube
.invoke DbufSwap

    JMP main_loop

; --------------------------------------------------
; load current frame -> points
; --------------------------------------------------
load_frame:
    LDA frame_idx
    ASL
    TAX
    LDA frame_table,X
    STA src_lo
    INX
    LDA frame_table,X
    STA src_hi

    LDY #$00
lf_loop:
    LDA (src_lo),Y
    STA points,Y
    INY
    CPY #$10
    BNE lf_loop
    RTS

; --------------------------------------------------
; draw all 12 edges
; --------------------------------------------------
draw_cube:
    LDA #$00
    STA edge_idx

dc_loop:
    LDY edge_idx

    LDA cube_edges,Y
    ASL
    TAX
    LDA points,X
    STA x0v
    LDA points+1,X
    STA y0v

    INY
    LDA cube_edges,Y
    ASL
    TAX
    LDA points,X
    STA x1v
    LDA points+1,X
    STA y1v

    JSR draw_line

    LDA edge_idx
    CLC
    ADC #$02
    STA edge_idx
    CMP #24
    BNE dc_loop
    RTS

; --------------------------------------------------
; edge list
; --------------------------------------------------
cube_edges:
.byte 0,1, 1,2, 2,3, 3,0
.byte 4,5, 5,6, 6,7, 7,4
.byte 0,4, 1,5, 2,6, 3,7

; --------------------------------------------------
; 16 precomputed perspective frames
; --------------------------------------------------
frame_table:
.byte <frame_0,  >frame_0
.byte <frame_1,  >frame_1
.byte <frame_2,  >frame_2
.byte <frame_3,  >frame_3
.byte <frame_4,  >frame_4
.byte <frame_5,  >frame_5
.byte <frame_6,  >frame_6
.byte <frame_7,  >frame_7
.byte <frame_8,  >frame_8
.byte <frame_9,  >frame_9
.byte <frame_10, >frame_10
.byte <frame_11, >frame_11
.byte <frame_12, >frame_12
.byte <frame_13, >frame_13
.byte <frame_14, >frame_14
.byte <frame_15, >frame_15

frame_1:

frame_2:

frame_4:

frame_5:

frame_6:

frame_7:

frame_10:
